answer: Pay each account's rewards only to a cash-out address it names in advance, then trace where those coins settle on the public ledger. Payouts that merge into the same wallets or exchange deposits within a few hops are treated like smoke from one plume and pooled into a single reward. Keeping N fakes paid separately means running N fully unlinked cash-out paths, each its own island with separate funding, timing and off-ramp, so upkeep and exposure spiral upward with every fake added.
